title: RSV4 Factory 1100
description: Engineered for riders seeking confident performance and refined dynamics, the Aprilia RSV4 Factory 1100 is tuned for spirited street performance with an intuitive wide-handlebar command. At its heart lies a 1100cc powertrain delivering 150 HP and 120 Nm of torque, tuned to translate its 230 kg mass into punchy mid-range acceleration. Riders are greeted by an ergonomic Upright Neutral posture paired with a balanced 790mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort, backed by a 19.5L fuel tank for extended saddle stints.
yoast_title: Aprilia RSV4 Factory 1100: Specs, Price & Recommended Helmets
yoast_metadesc: Complete specs, engine power, weight, and verified helmet compatibility guide for the Aprilia RSV4 Factory 1100.

qualitative_intelligence.rider_ergonomics_review: Committed, race-focused ergonomic posture. You sit 'in' the machine with a steep forward wrist load and high rear-set footpegs that lock your knees firmly into the tank cutouts. Ideal for aggressive cornering body steering on track days, though urban stop-and-go riding will test your wrist and neck endurance after 45 minutes.
qualitative_intelligence.engine_character_soundtrack: Intense, race-derived exhaust note that transforms from a deep, throaty rumble at idle into a fierce, screaming intake howl as you push past 8,000 RPM. The auto-blipper delivers crisp, satisfying pop-and-crackle downshifts on hard deceleration.
qualitative_intelligence.helmet_pairing_insights: Pair with an ECE 22.06 or FIM-homologated Track Full Face helmet (such as the Shoei X-Fifteen or AGV Pista GP RR). Look for helmets with a tall vertical eyeport—so you can see far down the track while in a full chin-on-tank tuck—and a rear aerodynamic spoiler to prevent helmet lift at 200+ km/h.
real_world_pros: Pinpoint front-end precision and razor-sharp apex carving
Searing top-end acceleration with comprehensive rider-aid electronics
Premium suspension components that soak up high-speed track ripples
real_world_cons: Aggressive wrist weight causes fatigue during slow-moving city traffic
Engine radiator heat warms inner thighs at red lights on hot days
qualitative_intelligence.editorial_verdict: The Aprilia & Moto Guzzi Aprilia RSV4 Factory 1100 delivers an authentic, satisfying riding experience in the Roadster / Commuter segment. With its 150 HP motor and well-balanced chassis geometry, Aprilia & Moto Guzzi has built a motorcycle that rewards riders with genuine feedback, practical daily usability, and solid overall engineering integrity.
qualitative_intelligence.canyon_cornering_personality: Easy, light-steering flickability at low speeds with stable, neutral tracking through city turns.
qualitative_intelligence.highway_crosswind_stability: Predictable highway tracking at legal speeds; extreme crosswinds over 45 km/h require slight handlebar counter-steering.
qualitative_intelligence.urban_heat_management: High radiator heat discharge on inner thighs during slow city traffic when ambient temps exceed 30°C; twin fans activate automatically to keep engine coolant optimal.

rider_fit_suitability_matrix.beginner_suitability_eval: Requires experienced wrist control and smooth throttle management; not recommended as a first bike.
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.maintenance_ease_index: 6.8 / 10 (Desmodromic/4-cylinder valve checks require specialized technician labor)
rider_fit_suitability_matrix.cold_weather_rain_rating: 5.5 / 10 (Minimal wind and rain coverage without aftermarket windshield)
